incorporatedInLastDays.title: Incorporated in the last N days
incorporatedInLastDays.description: New companies registered in the last N days, today included. Overrides the date fields below. 0 = use the dates below.

sicCodes.title: SIC codes
sicCodes.description: Nature of business codes, e.g. 62012 (software development), 56101 (restaurants), 68100 (buying and selling property), 43210 (electricians), 70229 (management consultancy). Each code runs as its own search; companies are not repeated.

location.title: Registered office location
location.description: Town, city or postcode in the registered office address, e.g. Manchester or SW1A.

nameIncludes.title: Company name includes
nameIncludes.description: Word or phrase in the company name, e.g. coffee.

nameExcludes.title: Company name excludes
nameExcludes.description: Skip companies whose name contains this.

companyNumbers.title: Or look up company numbers
companyNumbers.description: Company numbers such as 00445790 or SC906865. When given, the search filters above are ignored.

includeDetails.title: Add profile details and officers
includeDetails.description: Reads each company's page: accounts and confirmation-statement due dates, overdue flags, previous names and active directors and secretaries (name, role, appointed date, nationality, country of residence). Two extra page reads per company, billed as a detailed company.
